name: wowdeck-streamdeck-plugin
description: Bidirectional World of Warcraft Forever integration for Elgato Stream Deck (116 Slots)
author: Behmen

scripts.build:helper: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Stop-Process -Name 'wowdeck-helper' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150; if (Test-Path 'com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin\bin\wowdeck-helper.exe') { Remove-Item 'com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin\bin\wowdeck-helper.old.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Rename-Item 'com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin\bin\wowdeck-helper.exe' 'wowdeck-helper.old.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; & 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe' /nologo /optimize+ /target:exe /out:com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin\bin\wowdeck-helper.exe src\native\Win32Helper.cs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Remove-Item 'com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin\bin\wowdeck-helper.old.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0"
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=com.behmen.wowdeck.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js
scripts.build: npm run build:helper && tsc --noEmit && npm run build:js
